description.value: Central Kitchen + Bar is a locally owned restaurant and bar in downtown Kelowna's cultural district, founded in 2014 and repeatedly voted the city's best burger. The menu reaches well beyond burgers into globally-inspired starters, brunch service, cocktails, and a curated tap list, giving touring cyclists a full sit-down meal option in the heart of the city. The business has earned a devoted local following and the 2017 Best Employer BC Award.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at centralkelowna.com is active and corroborates the OSM address (1155 Ellis Street, Kelowna, BC V1Y1Z5) and provides a phone number (250-862-8820) absent from OSM. The homepage prominently features an 'Order Online for Delivery' button confirming takeout, while the menu lists vegan-labelled items and a customer review explicitly mentions a gluten-free pizza crust option. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device-charging information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Central Kitchen' but the website consistently uses 'Central Kitchen + Bar' and 'Central Kitchen & Bar' — OSM may be using an abbreviated name.
OSM cuisine tag is 'burger' but the restaurant offers a broad menu including tacos, salads, brunch, cocktails, and more — the tag undersells the offering.
OSM phone field is empty; phone number 250-862-8820 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible sit-down restaurant in downtown Kelowna with a live website and confirmed address. Clear candidate for the directory.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Mediterranean Falafel Tacos with vegan dill ranch, house vegan ranch offered with chicken wings; customer review states 'The gluten free pizza cruste blew my mind.'

wow_evidence: locally owned restaurant and bar in downtown Kelowna's cultural district, founded in 2014 and repeatedly voted the city's best burger
